```{r}
library(CMAverse)
library(medflex)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(psych)
library(DOS2)
library(optmatch)
library(RItools)
library(fastDummies)
```

```{r cleaning-pipeline}
# MASS (loaded by medflex) masks dplyr::select — use dplyr::select explicitly throughout
# ==========================================
# 1. LOAD & INITIAL FILTER
# ==========================================
df <- read.csv("master_data_2020.csv") %>%
  filter(!is.na(presvote20post))

treatment <- "untrustworthy_flag"
mediator  <- "encountered_fakenews1_post"

# ==========================================
# 2. OUTCOME VARIABLES
# ==========================================
df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    voted_biden_2020    = as.integer(trimws(as.character(presvote20post)) == "Joe Biden"),
    voted_trump_2020    = as.integer(trimws(as.character(presvote20post)) == "Donald Trump"),
    turnout_2020_binary = as.integer(
      !grepl("did not vote|skipped|__na__", trimws(as.character(presvote20post)), ignore.case = TRUE)
    )
  )

# ==========================================
# 3. FEATURE ENGINEERING
# ==========================================

# Digital Literacy Index — parse first numeric token from each tf column
tf_cols <- c("tf_adv", "tf_pdf", "tf_spy", "tf_wiki", "tf_cache", "tf_phishing")

parse_tf <- function(x) {
  first_word <- sub("\\s.*", "", trimws(as.character(x)))
  suppressWarnings(as.numeric(ifelse(grepl("^\\d+$", first_word), first_word, NA_real_)))
}

df$digital_literacy_index <- rowMeans(sapply(df[tf_cols], parse_tf), na.rm = TRUE)

# Ideology & Party ID
df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    ideo5_linear = case_when(
      ideo5 == "Very liberal"      ~ 1L,
      ideo5 == "Liberal"           ~ 2L,
      ideo5 == "Moderate"          ~ 3L,
      ideo5 == "Conservative"      ~ 4L,
      ideo5 == "Very conservative" ~ 5L
    ),
    pid7_linear = case_when(
      pid7 == "Strong Democrat"            ~ 1L,
      pid7 == "Not very strong Democrat"   ~ 2L,
      pid7 == "Lean Democrat"              ~ 3L,
      pid7 == "Independent"               ~ 4L,
      pid7 == "Lean Republican"           ~ 5L,
      pid7 == "Not very strong Republican" ~ 6L,
      pid7 == "Strong Republican"          ~ 7L
    )
  )

# Social Media Use (en-dash separators preserved from survey labels)
df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    socmed_use_linear = case_when(
      trimws(as.character(socmed_use)) == "Less than 10 minutes per day" ~ 1L,
      trimws(as.character(socmed_use)) == "10–30 minutes per day"   ~ 2L,
      trimws(as.character(socmed_use)) == "31–60 minutes per day"   ~ 3L,
      trimws(as.character(socmed_use)) == "1–2 hours per day"       ~ 4L,
      trimws(as.character(socmed_use)) == "2–3 hours per day"       ~ 5L,
      trimws(as.character(socmed_use)) == "More than 3 hours per day"    ~ 6L
    )
  )

# News Interest
df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    newsint_linear = case_when(
      trimws(as.character(newsint)) == "Hardly at all"     ~ 1L,
      trimws(as.character(newsint)) == "Only now and then" ~ 2L,
      trimws(as.character(newsint)) == "Some of the time"  ~ 3L,
      trimws(as.character(newsint)) == "Most of the time"  ~ 4L
    )
  )

# Internet Use Frequency (unmapped values fall back to 3, matching Python fillna(3))
df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    intuse_linear = case_when(
      trimws(as.character(intuse)) == "Less often"          ~ 1L,
      trimws(as.character(intuse)) == "A few times a week"  ~ 2L,
      trimws(as.character(intuse)) == "About once a day"    ~ 3L,
      trimws(as.character(intuse)) == "Several times a day" ~ 4L,
      TRUE                                                  ~ 3L
    )
  )

# 2016 Vote Condensed
df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    presvote16post_condensed = case_when(
      trimws(as.character(presvote16post)) == "Hillary Clinton" ~ "Hillary Clinton",
      trimws(as.character(presvote16post)) == "Donald Trump"    ~ "Donald Trump",
      is.na(presvote16post) |
        trimws(as.character(presvote16post)) %in%
          c("__NA__", "nan", "Did not vote", "Did not vote for President") ~ "Did Not Vote",
      TRUE ~ "Other"
    )
  )

# ==========================================
# 4. COMPLETE-CASE SELECTION
# ==========================================
core_cols             <- c(treatment, mediator,
                           "turnout_2020_binary", "voted_biden_2020", "voted_trump_2020",
                           "age", "female")
engineered_continuous <- "digital_literacy_index"
linear_features       <- c("ideo5_linear", "pid7_linear", "socmed_use_linear",
                            "newsint_linear", "intuse_linear")
categorical_covariates <- c("race4", "educ4", "region", "presvote16post_condensed")

all_cols <- c(core_cols, engineered_continuous, linear_features, categorical_covariates)

df_clean <- df %>%
  dplyr::select(all_of(all_cols)) %>%
  drop_na()

# ==========================================
# 5. DESIGN MATRIX WITH DUMMIES (BASELINES DROPPED)
# ==========================================
X_matrix <- df_clean %>%
  dplyr::select(age, female,
                all_of(engineered_continuous),
                all_of(linear_features),
                all_of(categorical_covariates)) %>%
  dummy_cols(
    select_columns          = categorical_covariates,
    remove_selected_columns = TRUE
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(-any_of(c(
    "presvote16post_condensed_Donald Trump",
    "race4_White",
    "educ4_College grad",
    "region_Midwest"
  )))

# ==========================================
# 6. FINAL EXTRACTIONS
# ==========================================
W         <- as.integer(df_clean[[treatment]])
M         <- df_clean[[mediator]]
Y_turnout <- as.integer(df_clean[["turnout_2020_binary"]])
Y_biden   <- as.integer(df_clean[["voted_biden_2020"]])
Y_trump   <- as.integer(df_clean[["voted_trump_2020"]])

cat("--- PIPELINE VERIFICATION ---\n")
cat(sprintf("Total valid sample size (N): %d\n",          nrow(df_clean)))
cat(sprintf("Total covariates in X_matrix: %d\n",         ncol(X_matrix)))
cat(sprintf("Mean 2020 Turnout rate: %.2f%%\n",           mean(Y_turnout) * 100))
cat(sprintf("Mean unconditional Biden support: %.2f%%\n", mean(Y_biden)   * 100))
cat(sprintf("Mean unconditional Trump support: %.2f%%\n", mean(Y_trump)   * 100))
```

---

### Mediation Analysis

**Causal structure:**
`untrustworthy_flag` → `encountered_fakenews1_post` → `voted_biden_2020` / `voted_trump_2020`

Both direct (NDE) and mediated (NIE) pathways are estimated using a regression-based natural effects model (`CMAverse::cmest`, `model = "rb"`) with bootstrap inference.

```{r mediation-prep}
# Inspect raw mediator values before any coercion
cat("Raw mediator distribution (encountered_fakenews1_post):\n")
print(table(df_clean$encountered_fakenews1_post, useNA = "always"))

# Factor-encode categoricals; coerce mediator to numeric
# If the mediator is text (e.g. "Yes"/"No"), recode it below before as.numeric()
df_med <- df_clean %>%
  mutate(
    race4                      = as.factor(race4),
    educ4                      = as.factor(educ4),
    region                     = as.factor(region),
    presvote16post_condensed   = as.factor(presvote16post_condensed),
    untrustworthy_flag         = as.integer(untrustworthy_flag),
    encountered_fakenews1_post = case_when(
      encountered_fakenews1_post == "I have not encountered any fake news" ~ 0L,
      encountered_fakenews1_post == "Not very much"                        ~ 1L,
      encountered_fakenews1_post == "A fair amount"                        ~ 2L,
      encountered_fakenews1_post == "A great deal"                         ~ 3L,
      encountered_fakenews1_post == "Nearly all news I see is fake"        ~ 4L
    )
  ) %>%
  drop_na()  # drop any rows with unrecognised mediator labels

basec_vars <- c(
  "age", "female", "digital_literacy_index",
  "ideo5_linear", "pid7_linear", "socmed_use_linear",
  "newsint_linear", "intuse_linear",
  "race4", "educ4", "region", "presvote16post_condensed"
)

cat(sprintf("\nRows after coercion drop: %d  (removed %d)\n",
            nrow(df_med), nrow(df_clean) - nrow(df_med)))
cat(sprintf("Mediator mean: %.3f  |  SD: %.3f\n",
            mean(df_med$encountered_fakenews1_post),
            sd(df_med$encountered_fakenews1_post)))
```

```{r run-mediation, cache=TRUE}
# Reduce nboot to 200 for faster iteration; raise to 1000 for final results
NBOOT <- 1000

cat("Running mediation for Biden vote...\n")
res_biden <- cmest(
  data       = df_med,
  model      = "rb",
  outcome    = "voted_biden_2020",
  exposure   = "untrustworthy_flag",
  mediator   = "encountered_fakenews1_post",
  basec      = basec_vars,
  EMint      = TRUE,
  mreg       = list("linear"),
  yreg       = "linear",   # linear probability model: effects on risk-difference scale;
                            # avoids log-odds NaN from perfect separation in bootstrap samples
  astar      = 0,
  a          = 1,
  mval       = list(mean(df_med$encountered_fakenews1_post, na.rm = TRUE)),
  estimation = "imputation",
  inference  = "bootstrap",
  nboot      = NBOOT
)

cat("Running mediation for Trump vote...\n")
res_trump <- cmest(
  data       = df_med,
  model      = "rb",
  outcome    = "voted_trump_2020",
  exposure   = "untrustworthy_flag",
  mediator   = "encountered_fakenews1_post",
  basec      = basec_vars,
  EMint      = TRUE,
  mreg       = list("linear"),
  yreg       = "linear",
  astar      = 0,
  a          = 1,
  mval       = list(mean(df_med$encountered_fakenews1_post, na.rm = TRUE)),
  estimation = "imputation",
  inference  = "bootstrap",
  nboot      = NBOOT
)
```

```{r results-tables}
# Helper: pull the five key effects from a cmest object into a tidy data frame
extract_effects <- function(res, outcome_label) {
  keys <- c("te", "pnde", "tnde", "pnie", "tnie")
  data.frame(
    outcome  = outcome_label,
    effect   = c("TE", "PNDE", "TNDE", "PNIE", "TNIE"),
    estimate = res$effect.pe[keys],
    ci_lower = res$effect.ci.low[keys],
    ci_upper = res$effect.ci.high[keys],
    pvalue   = res$effect.pval[keys],
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
    row.names = NULL
  )
}

results_biden <- extract_effects(res_biden, "Voted Biden")
results_trump <- extract_effects(res_trump, "Voted Trump")

all_results <- bind_rows(results_biden, results_trump) %>%
  mutate(
    effect_category = case_when(
      effect == "TE"                    ~ "Total Effect",
      effect %in% c("PNDE", "TNDE")    ~ "Natural Direct Effect",
      effect %in% c("PNIE", "TNIE")    ~ "Natural Indirect Effect"
    ),
    significant = pvalue < 0.05
  )

# Print summary table
summary_table <- all_results %>%
  mutate(
    CI       = sprintf("(%.3f, %.3f)", ci_lower, ci_upper),
    estimate = round(estimate, 4),
    pvalue   = round(pvalue, 4),
    sig      = ifelse(significant, "*", "")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(outcome, effect, estimate, CI, pvalue, sig)

cat("=== Mediation Results (Log-Odds Scale) ===\n")
print(summary_table)
```

```{r forest-plot, fig.width=10, fig.height=6}
effect_colors <- c(
  "Total Effect"            = "gray50",
  "Natural Direct Effect"   = "#0072B2",
  "Natural Indirect Effect" = "#009E73"
)

plot_data <- all_results %>%
  mutate(
    effect          = factor(effect, levels = c("TE", "PNDE", "TNDE", "PNIE", "TNIE")),
    effect_category = factor(effect_category,
                             levels = c("Total Effect",
                                        "Natural Direct Effect",
                                        "Natural Indirect Effect")),
    outcome         = factor(outcome, levels = c("Voted Biden", "Voted Trump")),
    shape_type      = ifelse(significant, 16, 1)
  )

forest_plot <- ggplot(plot_data,
                      aes(x = estimate, y = effect,
                          color = effect_category,
                          shape = as.factor(shape_type))) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50") +
  geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = ci_lower, xmax = ci_upper),
                 height = 0.25, linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(size = 3.5) +
  facet_wrap(~ outcome, ncol = 2, scales = "free_x") +
  scale_color_manual(values = effect_colors, name = "Effect Type") +
  scale_shape_manual(
    values = c("1" = 1, "16" = 16),
    labels = c("1" = "Non-significant", "16" = "p < 0.05"),
    name   = "Significance"
  ) +
  labs(
    x        = "Effect Estimate — Risk Difference Scale (95% Bootstrap CI)",
    y        = "Effect Type",
    title    = "Effect of Untrustworthy News Exposure on 2020 Vote Choice",
    subtitle = "Mediator: Encountered Fake News Post-Treatment  |  Covariates: age, sex, ideology, PID, education, race, region, media use, 2016 vote"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    strip.text         = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"),
    strip.background   = element_rect(fill = "gray90"),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "gray95"),
    panel.grid.minor   = element_blank(),
    axis.text          = element_text(size = 9),
    axis.title         = element_text(size = 10),
    plot.title         = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    plot.subtitle      = element_text(size = 7.5, hjust = 0.5, color = "gray40"),
    legend.position    = "bottom",
    legend.box         = "vertical"
  )

print(forest_plot)
ggsave("mediation_forest_plot.png", forest_plot, width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 300)
```

```{r sensitivity-analysis}
# E-values for unmeasured confounding of the NIE pathway
cat("=== E-Values: Biden Vote ===\n")
sens_biden    <- cmsens(object = res_biden, sens = "uc")
evalues_biden <- as.data.frame(sens_biden$evalues)
print(evalues_biden[c("pnie", "tnie"), ])

cat("\n=== E-Values: Trump Vote ===\n")
sens_trump    <- cmsens(object = res_trump, sens = "uc")
evalues_trump <- as.data.frame(sens_trump$evalues)
print(evalues_trump[c("pnie", "tnie"), ])
```
